name: Gnomeregan - Tinker's Court via Dungeon Finder names Thermaplugg as the objective and completes on his kill (#5621)
contract: #5621: in a Dungeon Finder run of a Gnomeregan wing the objective tracker read 'Defeat: Unknown'. The tracker names GetLFGBoss(), which the client resolves from the current LFG dungeon id (SMSG 0x66D) through DungeonEncounterExtra.dbc; row 382 (Mekgineer Thermaplugg 7800) is the final encounter of wing 1033 (Tinker's Court) in both the client and server DBC, and instance_encounters 382 has lastEncounterDungeon 1033 since #5164. Expected: on entering, p1 receives 0x66D carrying 1033, and crediting Thermaplugg completes the wing so the Classic Random reward of the 24-34 bracket is paid.

steps.label: The group is assigned Gnomeregan - Tinker's Court
DISCRIMINATING: the client is told its current LFG dungeon is 1033 (SMSG 0x66D), the id DungeonEncounterExtra.dbc resolves to Mekgineer Thermaplugg instead of 'Defeat: Unknown'
Mekgineer Thermaplugg, final boss of Gnomeregan - Tinker's Court, is credited
p1 is rewarded Classic Random 24-34 (1st) 24883: the boss kill completed the dungeon
p2 is rewarded Classic Random 24-34 (1st) 24883: the boss kill completed the dungeon
